pragmas.name: weak
pragmas.description: The next function or global is a weak definition.

pragmas.name: cc45 weak
pragmas.description: The next function or global is a weak definition.

pragmas.name: cc45 recurse
pragmas.description: The next function uses a stack frame instead of static allocation (needed for functions called both from an __interrupt handler and from mainline code; also silences the warning on recursive functions).

pragmas.name: cc45 signed_default
pragmas.description: Plain integer types signed / unsigned from here on.

pragmas.name: cc45 unsigned_default
pragmas.description: Plain integer types signed / unsigned from here on.

pragmas.name: section
pragmas.description: Declares a section for __section("<name>") variables and functions, at <addr> (or where another file or ln45 --section puts it): see Sections.

pragmas.name: cc45 section
pragmas.description: Declares a section for __section("<name>") variables and functions, at <addr> (or where another file or ln45 --section puts it): see Sections.

pragmas.name: cc45 overlay
pragmas.description: As -foverlay=<name>: this file's code is in the code overlay <name> (Code Overlays; <overlay.h>).

pragmas.name: cc45 optimize
pragmas.description: Switch IR optimization passes for the functions that follow (e.g. optimize(no-licm)); see optimizations.md.

pragmas.name: encoding
pragmas.description: Encoding of the string and character literals that follow (a p/s/a/@ prefix overrides it) (see String and Character Encodings).

pragmas.name: cc45 no_zp_save
pragmas.description: -S (standalone) output only: do not relocate the base page. Linked programs always run on __zp_page.

pragmas.name: no_zp_save
pragmas.description: -S (standalone) output only: do not relocate the base page. Linked programs always run on __zp_page.

pragmas.name: cc45 set_bp
pragmas.description: -S output only: set the base page to n (a **decimal** number; $40 is rejected).
